title: State integrals for the quantized SL₂(ℂ) Chern–Simons invariant
note: arXiv:2601.05136 (v2, May 2026). Expresses the McPhail-Snyder– Reshetikhin geometric-twist invariant Zψ_N(K,ρ,µ) (a quantization of the SL₂(ℂ) CS invariant / geometric twist of the Kashaev invariant) as a sum of state integrals built **directly from a knot diagram**: a discrete state-sum over crossings with a per- edge integer vector k ∈ Z^E, holonomy R-matrices, and a log-meridian µ / log-longitude λ. Worked for the 5₂ Kashaev invariant. This is the DIAGRAMMATIC (braid/crossing) route to the integer state-integral data — the complement to the Neumann–Zagier–datum route of fantini-wheeler2024, and the most direct literature realisation of the QOU 'braid word → integer cusp data' map (bean qou-qnnq): the k ∈ Z^E per-edge integers are attached to the diagram, and (µ,λ) are the cusp holonomy. Registered 2026-08-01 (c₃-via-Borel literature sweep).
